_doc: The models per role (docs/MODELS_NOTES.md). Every model of a role shares that role's body, skeleton, clips, contacts and outfits (characters/<role>.glb); a model adds its own face (<id>_identity.bin, tools/model/identity), skin albedos (<id>_skin_<tone>.jpg), eyes (<id>_eye.png) and hair style (hair/<style>.glb). fixedAge: the face was built at that age, the base's age shapes are not applied. tone: the skin tone a model starts with when picked. Adults only. hairColour: her hair colour preset (index into the Customize swatches) a model starts with.
